inlines.v: CURDLE, verb intransitive [sometimes written crudle. See Curd.] 1. To coagulate or concrete; to thicken, or change into curd. Milk curdles by a mixture of runnet. 2. To thicken; to congeal; as, the blood curdles in the veins. CURDLE, verb transitive 1. To change into curd; to cause to thicken, coagulate, or concrete. Runnet or brandy curdles milk. At Florence they curdle their milk with artichoke flowers. 2. To congeal or thicken. The recital curdled my blood.
